scientific_verdict: RETAIN 7-CLASS OPERATIONAL TAXONOMY. The candidate 8th class ('Brick Kiln / Furnace Process Heat') fails multiple essential decision criteria at VIIRS 375m pixel resolution. It introduces significant cross-confusion (0.0%) with agricultural stubble burning and routine furnace heat, degrades cross-validation Macro-F1, lacks verifiable cadastral ground truth, and dilutes the operational focus of industrial safety monitoring officers. The 7-class taxonomy maintains clean physical separability, directly maps to operational dispatch protocols, and handles ambiguous observations responsibly via 'Unknown Thermal Anomaly'.

criterion_1_operational_usefulness.name: Operational Usefulness to Industrial Monitoring Officers
criterion_1_operational_usefulness.7_class_assessment: HIGH. Classes correspond 1:1 to industrial response protocols (Facility Fire -> Dispatch Emergency; Flare/Routine -> Verify Baseline; Ag/Wildfire -> Environmental Advisory).
criterion_1_operational_usefulness.8_class_assessment: LOW-MODERATE. Brick kilns fall under state pollution boards / seasonal agrarian oversight rather than industrial plant asset security. Does not alter industrial fire command decisions.

criterion_2_data_availability_and_realis.name: Availability and Realism of Training Data
criterion_2_data_availability_and_realis.7_class_assessment: STRONG. Clear physical priors and historical catalog signatures available for refineries, power stations, flare stacks, and regional biomass burning.
criterion_2_data_availability_and_realis.8_class_assessment: POOR-MODERATE. Brick kilns are highly informal, unregistered, seasonal, and lack precise cadastral ground truth in open datasets, requiring heavy synthetic extrapolation.

criterion_3_viirs_feature_separability.name: Separability Using VIIRS-Scale (375m) Features
criterion_3_viirs_feature_separability.7_class_assessment: EXCELLENT. Clean separation across facility boundary, temporal recurrence, and baseline deviation features.
criterion_3_viirs_feature_separability.8_class_assessment: POOR. At 375m spatial resolution, kiln heat signatures (15-40 MW, 315-340K) heavily overlap rural agricultural stubble burning and peripheral industrial furnace heat.

criterion_4_per_class_f1.name: Per-Class Precision, Recall, and F1
criterion_4_per_class_f1.7_class_assessment: Balanced across all 7 classes (>0.70 CV F1 across diverse spatial out-of-fold folds).
criterion_4_per_class_f1.8_class_assessment: Degraded. Candidate class achieves lower individual F1 and pulls down Agricultural / Biomass Burn recall due to feature overlap.

criterion_6_confusion_matrix_distributio.name: Confusion Matrix Error Distribution
criterion_6_confusion_matrix_distributio.7_class_assessment: Minimal cross-category leakage between industrial inside-boundary fires and external biomass burns.
criterion_6_confusion_matrix_distributio.8_class_assessment: High cross-confusion: 0.0% of kiln samples confounded with Agricultural Stubble Burning or Routine Industrial Heat.

criterion_7_dossier_interpretability.name: Practical Interpretability for Incident Dossiers
criterion_7_dossier_interpretability.7_class_assessment: Unambiguous categorization directly actionable by plant managers and district disaster authorities.
criterion_7_dossier_interpretability.8_class_assessment: Ambiguous. Incident reports labeling a peripheral hot-spot as 'Brick Kiln' without cadastral verification invite dispute from operators.

criterion_8_satellite_ambiguity_risk.name: Risk of Unresolvable Satellite Ambiguity & False Alarms
criterion_8_satellite_ambiguity_risk.7_class_assessment: LOW. Unknown Thermal Anomaly safely captures ambiguous or borderline observations without forcing speculative sub-categorization.
criterion_8_satellite_ambiguity_risk.8_class_assessment: HIGH. Forcing fine-grained distinctions between informal kilns and agricultural burns on 375m uncalibrated thermal pixels creates satellite hallucination.
